name: Tom Eliaz
current_role: Co-founder & VP of Engineering, Bedrock Robotics
profile: Software engineering leader who co-founded Bedrock Robotics (autonomy retrofits for excavators and heavy construction equipment) in 2024 with ex-Waymo leaders Boris Sofman, Kevin Peterson and Ajay Gummalla. Previously spent ~5 years at Segment/Twilio, rising to VP of Engineering (Twilio Engage, high-scale computation and AI efforts). Penn computer science graduate.
interesting_fact: Unlike his ex-Waymo co-founders, Eliaz came from data infrastructure rather than self-driving: he was VP of Engineering at Twilio, leading multiple products plus high-scale computation and AI efforts.
deep_cut_fact: Before Segment he was an early employee at Anki, the AI robot-toy startup, where he led cloud platforms - and earlier founded a healthcare technology company focused on improving care for patients with chronic conditions.
notes: Speaks at engineering-leadership events (ELC San Francisco) - an engineering-culture angle may resonate. Location reported as NY or SF depending on source.

name: Geoffrey Chaiken
profile: Yale (2004) and Harvard MBA (2009) graduate who co-founded Blink Health with his brother Matthew; it launched publicly in Feb 2016 letting patients prepay for discounted prescriptions regardless of insurance. The company has since pivoted to BlinkRx, a pharma-partnered platform for home delivery of branded medicines. Earlier he was one of three investors at Brave Warrior Advisors (~$3B AUM).
interesting_fact: Blink Health let uninsured and insured patients alike pay for lower-priced prescriptions online and pick them up at their preferred pharmacy; it now operates as BlinkRx delivering branded drugs in all 50 states.
deep_cut_fact: Early in his career he founded Marinus Pharmaceuticals (epilepsy treatments), licensed its lead product and closed its $30M financing - billed as the largest financing of its kind in Connecticut history.
notes: No published press email found (search budget ran out before a press-release media contact could be located; check recent BlinkRx press releases). Co-founded with brother Matthew Chaiken (also in wave 12, lane 082).

name: Felix Garriau
profile: Belgian marketer and innovation specialist who co-founded developer-first security platform Aikido Security in 2022 with Willem Delbare, Roeland Delrue and Madeline Lawrence; he leads marketing. Aikido is described as the fastest European cybersecurity company to reach unicorn status.
interesting_fact: Aikido was founded in 2022 and by 2026 had 350+ employees and offices in Ghent, San Francisco, Chicago, London, Singapore and Boston.
deep_cut_fact: Before Aikido he worked in innovation rather than security: CMO of innovation agency nexxworks, then a venture builder at AREA42.
notes: As CMO he is the most media-facing natural entry point at Aikido; press@aikido.dev likely reaches his team.
